introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.description: Welcome to MedCure. By accessing and using our services, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions set forth in this document. Please read carefully before using the service.

definitions.title: 2. Definitions
definitions.description: In these terms, the following terms are understood as follows:

items.serviceValue: The MedCure online medical appointment booking platform and all related features
items.userValue: Any individual who registers and uses MedCure services
items.healthcareValue: Hospitals, clinics, doctors and healthcare providers partnering with MedCure
items.contentValue: All information, text, images, videos and data displayed on the platform

accountRegistration.title: 3. Account Registration
accountRegistration.description: To fully use MedCure features, you need to register an account with the following conditions:
items: You must be 18 years or older or have consent from a legal guardian
Registration information must be accurate, complete and up-to-date
You are responsible for keeping your login information secure
Each person may only register one account
You must notify us immediately if you discover unauthorized access to your account

serviceUsage.title: 4. Service Usage
serviceUsage.description: When using MedCure services, you agree to:
items: Use the service for lawful and appropriate purposes
Not use the service to harm others or the system
Not interfere with the normal operation of the platform
Not collect other users' information without consent
Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
Not post content that violates the law or third-party rights

items.confirmationValue: Appointments are only confirmed after receiving notification from the system
items.cancellationValue: You can cancel appointments 24 hours in advance without charge. Late cancellation may incur fees
items.rescheduleValue: Appointments can be rescheduled depending on availability at the healthcare facility
items.noShowValue: Not showing up without notice may affect your service usage rights

paymentTerms.title: 6. Payment Terms
items: Service prices are clearly displayed before booking
Payment can be made through supported methods
Deposit fees (if any) will be deducted from the total consultation cost
Refunds are processed according to MedCure's refund policy

limitation.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
limitation.description: In all cases, MedCure's liability to you shall not exceed the amount you have paid for services in the most recent 12 months. This applies to all types of damages, whether direct or indirect.

termination.description: MedCure reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account if:

Providing false or fraudulent information

changes.description: MedCure reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon posting on the platform. Continued use of the service after changes means you accept the new terms.

governingLaw.description: These terms are governed and interpreted according to Vietnamese law. Any disputes arising will be resolved at competent courts in Vietnam.
